page.layout: One printed page, no text blocks. The only visible print is show-through from the reverse side, mirrored and faint: a large title block in the centre and a faint line at the very top edge.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from show-through. The large mirrored block in the centre (reading as "S. JOHANNIS / APOSTOLI / EPISTOLAE / CATHOLICAE / SCHOLIA.", with a numeral above it) is mirrored text from the other side of the leaf, so it is not transcribed.
